articles.title: Mississauga’s mayoral race is neck and neck, poll suggests
articles.summary: The race for becoming Mississauga’s next mayor is currently a coin toss between former mayor Bonnie Crombie and current mayor Carolyn Parrish, a new poll suggests.

articles.title: Stellantis is considering closing and selling Brampton assembly plant, Unifor says
articles.summary: A national union says it was told by Stellantis this week that it is seriously considering the closure and sale of the Brampton assembly plant. In a statement, Stellantis said its focus remains on finding a sustainable manufacturing solution for the plant.

articles.title: Stellantis seriously considering closure and sale of idled Brampton plant: union
articles.summary: TORONTO — Unifor says Stellantis is seriously considering the closure and sale of its Brampton, Ont., assembly plant, which has been idled since 2023.

articles.title: A timeline of Luigi Mangione’s criminal cases in the killing of UnitedHealthcare’s CEO
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Luigi Mangione’s guilty plea Friday to federal stalking charges in the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson resolved one of two cases against him in the executive's death. He is scheduled to go on trial on state murder charges on Sept. 8. His sentencing in the federal case is set for Dec. 18.

articles.title: A Canadian payment giant is being sold to U.S. private equity. Is your digital privacy at risk?
articles.summary: Royal Bank of Canada and Bank of Montreal are selling payment processor Moneris Solutions Corp. to San Francisco-based investment firm Francisco Partners. Some analysts are raising concerns around what the deal means for Canada's digital sovereignty amid the country's trade war with the U.S.

articles.title: Man arrested after Toronto police officer shot in e-bike robbery investigation
